description: Full stack engineer on healthcare rewards products: first a rewards app for a Fortune 500 health client, then, since June 2026, a greenfield rewards platform built from scratch. Promoted from Full Stack Software Engineer to Senior in April 2026.

Own all six member journeys on iOS and Android: screens, Auth0 PKCE authentication, and the backend wiring behind each

Created the platform's Next.js BFF and deployed it to Vercel

Reviewed nearly 300 pull requests in five months; onboarded a principal engineer and handed off mobile build and release ownership

Prior project, a rewards app for a Fortune 500 health client: owned a complex eligibility feature end to end three months after joining. It was scoped as minor UI work; I delivered it full stack, through the backend and business logic, against a hard year-end deadline
1st of 20 teams, North American AI Hackathon (sole engineer) · Rookie of the Year 2026
